<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has provided a list of times that work for Elena and David. I need to compare this list with the free times for Priya and Marcus to find a common slot.

Here is the list of free slots for Elena and David:
Mon: 11:00, 11:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30, 14:00
Wed: 13:00, 13:30
Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
Fri: 15:00, 15:30

Now, I will check the availability of Priya and Marcus for each of these slots.

**Monday 11:00, 11:30:**
- Priya is busy from 11:00-11:30 (Travel) and 11:30-12:00 (Contract review).
- Marcus is free at 11:00-11:30, but busy 11:30-12:00.
So, Monday doesn't work.

**Tuesday 09:00, 09:30, 14:00:**
- Priya is busy 09:00-09:30 (Board prep), 09:30-10:00 (Partner lunch), and 14:00-14:30 (Quarterly planning).
- Marcus is busy 09:00-09:30 (Recruiting call), 09:30-10:00 (Litigation strategy) and 14:00-14:30 (Partner lunch).
So, Tuesday doesn't work.

**Wednesday 13:00, 13:30:**
- Priya is busy 13:00-13:30 (Client call) and 13:30-14:00 (Client dinner prep).
- Marcus is busy 13:00-13:30 (Partner lunch) and 13:30-14:00 (Litigation strategy).
So, Wednesday doesn't work.

**Thursday 09:30, 14:30, 15:00:**
- Priya is busy 09:30-10:00 (Busy), but free at 14:30-15:00. She is busy 15:00-15:30 (Client dinner prep).
- Marcus is busy 09:30-10:00 (Contract review), and busy 14:30-15:00 (Dentist appointment) and 15:00-15:30 (Board prep).
So, Thursday doesn't work.

**Friday 15:00, 15:30:**
- Priya is busy 15:00-15:30 (Hiring panel) and 15:30-16:00 (Contract review).
- Marcus is busy 15:00-15:30 (Travel) and 15:30-16:00 (Busy).
So, Friday doesn't work.

It appears none of the times Brad suggested work for Priya and Marcus. This means there are no common slots. I should double-check my initial analysis of Priya and Marcus's free times, and if it is correct, then I should report that the task is infeasible.

Let me re-check my free time analysis from the first session.

**Priya's Free Times:**
Mon: 09:00-10:00, 13:00-14:00
Tue: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 09:00-09:30, 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00
Thu: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00
Fri: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30

**Marcus's Free Times:**
Mon: 09:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30, 15:00-15:30
Tue: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 09:00-09:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00
Thu: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30
Fri: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00

**Common Free Times for Priya and Marcus:**
Mon: 09:00-10:00. This gives us 09:00, 09:30.
Tue: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00. This gives us 13:00, 13:30, 16:30.
Wed: 09:00-09:30, 15:00-16:00. This gives us 09:00, 15:00, 15:30.
Thu: 10:00-10:30. This gives us 10:00.
Fri: 11:00-12:00. This gives us 11:00, 11:30.

My initial analysis was mostly correct, but I missed Wed 09:00. I will send the corrected list to Brad.

My new list of slots for Priya and Marcus is:
Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 09:00, 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Brad's list for Elena and David:
Mon: 11:00, 11:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30, 14:00
Wed: 13:00, 13:30
Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
Fri: 15:00, 15:30

There is no overlap between these two lists. It seems that there are no available slots for all four partners. I will report this to Brad and suggest that we report this as infeasible. Maybe he can double-check his side as well.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
